answer: The glacier counter is kept in zephyr and karst reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2661 identities would post 1317 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
